skeleton: snail seen from the side facing right: root on the ground; body (the slimy foot with the head rising at the right) with squash; shell on the body's back; stalkL/stalkR rooted inside the head (behind the body, so the head's edge covers their base), each with an eye bone at its tip carrying the eye ball (face pieces); mouth on the head. The eye bones undo their stalk's stretch so the balls stay round.

sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a snail character. Draw this exact snail as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the shell: the spiral brown shell, alone.
2. the body: the pale green slimy body and foot with its head rising up on the right as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no mouth — keep the rosy cheek; without the eye stalks.
3. one eye stalk: a thin green stalk with no eye ball on its tip, both ends rounded.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a snail character; image 2 shows the same snail cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the snail's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the snail in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. one of the snail's eyes as it is in image 1: only the round green ball at the very tip of the eye stalk, with its white eye, dark pupil and sparkle on it — the ball alone, with NO stalk below it, its bottom edge a full round curve like the rest of the ball. Every eye below is this same ball, without any stalk.
2. the same green ball with the eye wide open and surprised: the white eye bigger and rounder, with its sparkle.
3. the same green ball with its eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same green ball with the eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same green ball with the eye sad: looking down, its lid drooping.
6. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small calm smile.
7. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
8. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
9. the mouth in a small sad frown.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the snail pulls its head and eye stalks into its shell, waits there, then slowly peeks out again and looks around.

pause.shows: the snail hidden inside its shell: only the shell shows

animations.description: the snail glides along on its foot, eye stalks bobbing, and settles.
the snail turns its eye stalks one way, then the other, then back.
the snail wiggles its eye stalks this way and that, very pleased with itself.
the snail stretches its neck up tall with a big yawn, then settles back down.

pause.shows: the snail stretched up tall, yawning

animations.description: the snail waves hello with one of its eye stalks.
the snail shakes its head no, eye stalks swinging.
the snail laughs and laughs, bouncing with giggles.
the snail talks, its mouth moving, its head bobbing a little.
the snail shivers and trembles, cold or scared.
the snail cries, eye stalks drooping, its body shaking with little sobs.
the snail gives a big yawn, lets its eye stalks droop and falls asleep, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.

pause.shows: the snail fast asleep, eye stalks drooping, eyes shut

animations.description: the snail gives a happy little hop and lands with a squash.
the snail does a happy little dance, swaying from side to side.
the snail stretches both eye stalks out long and peers hard at something, then pulls them back in.

pause.shows: the snail with both eye stalks stretched out long, peering
